canonical_state_binding: canonical_state is validated directly by military_slices.models.CanonicalState.model_validate; no adapter inference
aperture_request_binding: aperture_request is converted field-for-field into military_slices.adaptive_resolver_aperture.ApertureRequest; no adapter inference
mode_a_requirement: CanonicalState must contain the real governed Decision, MutationEvent, LineageRecord, and derived indexes produced by existing state-bound rejection contracts. aperture_request must contain the exact reuse fact IDs and validity dimensions.
mode_e_requirement: aperture_request must contain an explicit governed permitted_latent_fact_id and probe_discovery_permitted value. BHE performs no selection or inference of either value.
probe_contract: existing frozen Probe SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION and ProbeDecision schema
authority_effect: none; Resolver and Probe outputs remain proposals under existing Governor/Gate validation
